pitfalls.summary: The plugin's own REST API (wc/v3/wishlist/*) only offers a per-user get_by_user/{user_id} route, no bulk collection endpoint. structure-bridge-plugin reads the dedicated tinvwl_lists table directly instead. VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29 against poratus.wpcomstaging.com: discover-structure returned tinvwl_lists's real 7-column schema, query-structure returned 70 real rows.

Wix has a real native Wishlist API (com.wixpress.wishlist.Wishlist, fqdn wix.platform.v1.wishlist -- confirmed 2026-08-29 from its internal proto, NOT wix.ecom.v1.wishlist as an earlier orphaned attempt assumed), but its write RPCs are member-session-scoped only with no backend bulk-write path -- unusable for a migration import. See rp-target-wix/domains/ecom/entities/wishlist-item.json for the full writeup. DECIDED 2026-08-29: land in a Wix CMS collection instead for now (see this entity's blocked[].fulfillment below); revisit the native target if a backend write path is ever added.

blocked.resolution: wix-wp-plugin-v2's discover-structure/query-structure routes read the tinvwl_lists table directly -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29 against poratus.wpcomstaging.com: discover-structure returned tinvwl_lists's real 7-column schema, query-structure returned 70 real rows. Native Wix Wishlist write has no backend path (see no-native-wix-target-verified pitfall) -- lands in a Wix CMS collection instead, decided 2026-08-29.

pitfalls.summary: product_id/variation_id reference WooCommerce products by source id -- must be crosswalked to Wix catalog ids, not carried as-is.

blocked.resolution: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29 against poratus.wpcomstaging.com: discover-structure returned tinvwl_items's real 10-column schema, query-structure returned 50 real rows. Native Wix Wishlist write has no backend path (see wishlist-definition's no-native-wix-target-verified pitfall) -- lands in a Wix CMS collection instead, decided 2026-08-29.

quirks: wishlist_id in tinvwl_items joins to tinvwl_lists.ID; author=0 rows are guest wishlists (no user reference).
Live-verified 2026-08-29: 70 real wishlists (tinvwl_lists) and 50 real wishlist items (tinvwl_items) on poratus.wpcomstaging.com.

Target decided 2026-08-29: Wix CMS collection, not the native Wishlist API -- see rp-target-wix/domains/ecom/entities/wishlist-item.json for the full gap writeup (real native API exists, but has no backend/service-account write path usable for a migration import).
